## What it is
Upload a vendor's statement (its list of open invoices, credits and payments) and xtraCHEF matches each line to the invoices in your account. It flags anything missing or with a different amount, so you don't overpay or pay for invoices that were never received.

## When you'd use it
- Monthly, for each vendor that sends statements (broadliners, beverage distributors).
- Before paying a statement balance.
- When chasing missing credits.

## How to do it
**Open**: **Statements** in the left nav. If it's missing, email support@xtrachef.com.

**Upload**
1. Click **Upload Statement** (top right).
2. On **Upload Invoice/Receipt**, drag and drop or browse.
3. Choose the **location**, then click **Submit**. The statement waits for xtraCHEF review.
- **PDF only, 25 MB maximum per file.**

**Review**
- The list defaults to your default location and the current month. Change the filters as needed.
- **Pencil icon**: open a statement with status **Reviewed** or **Ready for Reconciliation**. **Eye icon**: a **Rejected** statement, view only.
- Detail view: statement columns (**Date, Document Type, Document Number, Reference Number, Amount**) sit next to the matched xtraCHEF **Invoice** column, plus **Status, Reviewed, Comment**. If no invoice auto-matches, use **Search** and the **From/To Date** fields.

**Status icons**
- **Unmatched** (caution icon): no matching xtraCHEF transaction. The invoice may never have been received, never uploaded, or rejected. Find it or re-upload it.
- **Blue caution icon**: matched, but the **amounts differ**.

**Mark reviewed / comment**
- Click the **review icon** to mark a line reviewed (green). Click again to undo.
- Click the **comment icon**, type a note, then **Save**. Use it together with Reviewed to explain lines that were unmatched.

**Finish**: when every line has a match, click **Submit** or **Reconcile**. The status changes to reviewed.

**Extras**: **eye icon** to view the source document, **Download Report** for a reconciliation report of selected lines, **Audit** for a searchable history of changes.

## Settings, options & permissions
- Statement upload is available to TA, EX, RM and RU. The Statements tab on a vendor page is **Pro only**.

## Rules, limits & gotchas
- Statements are informational. Uploading one doesn't create a payable.
- Uploaded statements are reviewed by xtraCHEF before you can reconcile them, so allow some time.

## Automation / efficiency angles
- Month-end routine for each major vendor: upload the statement, clear the Unmatched lines (usually invoices never uploaded, or credits never entered), fix the blue amount mismatches (price disputes or short shipments), then reconcile. Download the report for the bookkeeper.
- An unmatched invoice is also missing from QBO. Each one found here is a bill that would otherwise get paid without being recorded, or missed entirely.
- Ask vendors to email statements to the xcinvoice address, or forward them in a batch.
